list.noMatchesHint: Check the spelling, or look under All.
list.noMatchesHintAll: Check the spelling, or try a shorter word.
list.noArchivedHint: What you archive leaves your lists but is never deleted. You find it here.
list.archiveBody: It leaves your lists and pickers. Nothing is deleted: its history stays, and you can bring it back from Archived any time.
list.archiveBodyPair: It leaves your lists and pickers, in Products & Services and where you buy it. Nothing is deleted: its history stays, and you can bring it back from Archived any time.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: In any language, the way you and your team call it.
form.editDescription: Change its details. What you recorded before stays as it was.
form.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Close it and open it again to see the latest details.
form.fixErrors: Check the fields with a note under them.

numbers.positive: Enter a number more than zero.

materials.intro: What you buy to make or sell. Enter each one once, in the unit you use it in.
materials.intro_retail: What you buy to sell. Enter each item once, in the unit you sell it by.
materials.addUsedHint: Something you use and do not sell, like bags or wrapping.
materials.newDescription: Its name, the unit you use it in and the packs you buy it in. Prices come from your purchases.

empty.title: No materials yet
empty.body: Start with what you buy most often. Pick the unit you use it in (kg, L or piece), then add the packs you buy it in, like a carton of 12 bottles. Prices come later, from your purchases.
empty.body_retail: Start with what you sell most. Give it the unit you sell it by (a piece, kg or L) and the packs you buy it in, like a carton of 24. Prices come later, from your purchases.
empty.viewer: Nothing has been added here yet.

materials.unitHint: Its cost is worked out per this unit, whatever pack you buy it in.
materials.unitRequired: Pick the unit you use it in.
materials.soldAsNote: You sell it as it is: its name, unit and archiving change with it in Products & Services too.
materials.unitInUse: Still used in: {{names}}. Change what goes into it first, then take out the pack or unit.
materials.unitInUse_food: Still used in the recipe of: {{names}}. Change the recipe first, then take out the pack or unit.

packs.title: Packs you buy it in
packs.hint: Add each size you buy, like a carton of 12 bottles. Then you can enter purchases the way you buy.
packs.name: Pack name
packs.cycle: {{chain}}: a pack can't hold itself. Pick another unit for one of them.
packs.wrongDimension: This is another kind of measure. Pick a unit like the one you use it in, or add a conversion below.
packs.tooLarge: This pack is more than BizCost can count. Check the number.
packs.tooSmall: This pack is less than BizCost can count. Check the number.

cross.title: Also measured another way
cross.hint: Only if you buy it in another kind of measure. For example, oil you use by weight but buy in litres: 1 L = 920 g.
cross.sameKind: Pick another kind of measure than the one you use it in.
cross.duplicate: You already have a conversion for this kind of measure.
cross.wrongTarget: Pick a unit like the one you use it in.
cross.tooLarge: This is more than BizCost can count. Check the number.
cross.tooSmall: This is less than BizCost can count. Check the number.

basis.purchases_90_days: from your purchases of the last 90 days
basis.last_purchase: from your last purchase (none in the last 90 days)

cost.noPrice: No price yet. It shows once a first purchase is final.

products.intro: Everything you sell, with its usual price. Enter each one once.
products.newDescription: What it is, how you sell it and its usual price.

empty.title: No products or services yet
empty.title_projects: No services or work items yet
empty.body: Start with what you sell most. Give it a name, the unit you sell it by and its usual price. What goes into it comes later.
empty.viewer: Nothing has been added here yet.

type.label: What is it?
type.productHint: Something you make or buy to sell
type.serviceHint: Work you do for a customer

resale.label: Bought ready to sell
resale.hint: You record buying it in Purchases, and its cost is what you pay for it.
resale.hint_food: You record buying it in Purchases, and its cost is what you pay for it. No recipe needed.
resale.readOnly: You buy it ready to sell: its cost is what you pay for it in Purchases.
resale.sameIn: Its name and unit change in Materials too.
resale.sameIn_food: Its name and unit change in Ingredients & supplies too.
resale.sameIn_factory: Its name and unit change in Raw materials too.
resale.sameIn_retail: Its name and unit change in Goods too.
resale.unitHint: The same kind of measure as its packs: a piece, a weight or a volume.

products.unitHint: How you count it when you sell it: per piece, per kg, per hour…
products.priceHint: For one unit. Leave it empty if the price changes each time.
products.descriptionHint: Optional. For you and your team.

vat.title: VAT
vat.includesHint: Turn this on if your price already has VAT in it, as shop prices usually do.

locations.title: Where it's sold
locations.readOnlyNote: Only people who manage branches can change this.

recipes.title: Materials used
recipes.description: Quantities {{per}}. Costs come from your purchases.
recipes.empty: Add each material it uses, and how much {{per}}. Packaging counts too: a cup, a lid, a box.
recipes.empty_food: Add each ingredient and supply it uses, and how much {{per}}. Packaging counts too: a cup, a lid, a straw.
recipes.empty_factory: Add each raw material it uses, and how much {{per}}. Packaging counts too: a box, a label, a wrap.
recipes.empty_retail: Add each item it uses, and how much {{per}}. Packaging counts too: a box, a bag, a ribbon.
recipes.viewerEmpty: Nothing has been added here yet.
recipes.noMaterials: Add your materials first, then say what goes into it.
recipes.noMaterials_food: Add your ingredients and supplies first, then write the recipe.
recipes.noMaterials_factory: Add your raw materials first, then say what goes into it.
recipes.noMaterials_retail: Add your goods first, then say what goes into it.
recipes.noPriceHint: Prices show once a first purchase is final.
recipes.incomplete_one: Incomplete: {{count}} item has no price yet ({{names}})
recipes.incomplete_other: Incomplete: {{count}} items have no price yet ({{names}})
recipes.basis: Each cost is the average of your purchases of the last 90 days, or your last purchase if you didn't buy it in that time. Shown rounded; BizCost keeps the exact amount.
recipes.lockedCosts: You can see the quantities. Costs are hidden for your role.
recipes.discardBody: What you changed here isn't saved yet.
recipes.duplicate: This is already on another line. Change that line instead.
recipes.tooSmall: This is less than BizCost can count. Use a bigger unit.
recipes.tooLarge: This is more than BizCost can count. Check the number.
recipes.tooMany_one: You can add up to {{count}} line.
recipes.tooMany_other: You can add up to {{count}} lines.
